svg.title: Four Core Seats, Six at Scaled Volume
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-to-six-person-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Four Core Seats, Six at Scaled Volume; subtitle: Two full-time and two contractor seats expand to three of each.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Each bar represents one distinct pod seat; the final two seats activate only in the Scaled scenario. External drivers are delivery capacity outside the pod count. Contractor designation requires a supportable relationship under applicable law.; caption: Base capacity is not round-the-clock staffing. Sell only coverage windows supported by the roster and documented backup arrangements.; stages: label: Core FT: owner and account lead; value: One full-time seat owns contracts, capacity, and cash; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Approve pricing, review receivable aging, maintain payer relationships, and own escalation decisions. Separate operating seat compensation from residual owner profit.; label: Core FT: dispatch operations lead; value: One full-time seat owns live routing and service evidence; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Manage RouteGenie or MediRoutes workflows, provider availability, missed pickups, and shift handoffs. Protect specimen and passenger workflows from accidental mixing.; label: Core C: claims and collections specialist; value: One contractor seat owns billing quality and receivable follow-up; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Validate required 837P fields or broker invoice files, resolve denials, reconcile remittances, and escalate Net-30/45 slippage before settlement cash becomes constrained.; label: Core C: credential and quality specialist; value: One contractor seat owns provider records and evidence sampling; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Track credential expiration, insurance evidence, trip-log completeness, and barcode custody exceptions. Structure the engagement around a lawful service relationship.; label: Scaled FT: second operations dispatcher; value: One additional full-time seat extends supported coverage windows; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Add this seat for the canonical three-FT configuration as concurrent assignments and recovery workload exceed the documented capacity of the core operations lead.; label: Scaled C: route onboarding specialist; value: One additional contractor seat implements newly awarded service routes; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Add this seat for the canonical three-contractor configuration; document stop instructions, provider readiness, laboratory contacts, and route acceptance evidence.
